claim: On Nov. 18, 2026, Voyager 1 becomes the first human-made object one light-day from Earth: 16.094 billion miles (25.902 billion km), so a radio signal takes 24 hours each way.

beats.caption: Voyager 1 is almost one light-day away
beats.vo: Voyager 1 is almost one light-day away.

beats.caption: Launched 1977. Still flying.
beats.vo: It launched in 1977, and it is still flying outward. On November eighteenth, it will be sixteen billion miles from Earth.

beats.caption: One light-day = how far light travels in 24 hours
beats.vo: A light-day is the distance light travels in twenty-four hours. Radio signals travel at that same speed, so that is the fastest any message can go.

beats.caption: 4x the Sun-to-Pluto distance
beats.vo: That is more than four times the distance from the Sun to Pluto. And it will be the first human-made object to get that far.

beats.caption: Send a command. Wait a day. Wait another for the reply.
beats.vo: So a command from Earth takes a full day to reach it. Its reply takes another day. Ask one question, then wait two days.

beats.caption: Would you wait 2 days for a reply?
beats.vo: Would you wait two days for a reply?
